stem.en: Carrot phloem cells were grown in three ways. In P there was light, no air and a solid medium with nutrients. In Q there was light, air and a liquid medium with nutrients. In R there was no light, air and a liquid medium with nutrients. The fresh weight of the cells went down in P and in R, and went up by 20 per cent in Q. Which statement does this result support?

text.en: Any liquid medium with nutrients makes the cells grow, whether or not there is light.

feedback.en: No. R had a liquid medium with nutrients but no light, and the weight of the cells went down.

text.en: Of these three sets, the cells grew only in the one with light, air and a liquid medium together.

feedback.en: Yes. Q was the only set with all three, and it was the only set in which the weight went up.

text.en: Air alone is enough for growth, so the cells grew in every set that had air in it.

feedback.en: No. R had air, but the weight of the cells still went down, so air alone was not enough.

text.en: The cells in P lost the most weight of all, because a solid medium is always the worst one for the growth of cells.

feedback.en: No. The weight went down in both P and R, but the result does not say which went down more.

explanation.en: Look for the one set in which the cells gained weight. Only Q had light, air and a liquid medium together, and only Q showed an increase, of 20 per cent. P had no air and a solid medium, R had no light, and both lost weight. The result says only "reduced" for P and R, so it cannot tell you which of the two was lowest.

hints.en: In which set did the weight go up? What did that set have?
Does the result give a number for P and R, or only the word reduced?
